title: Biden Signs Executive Order Aiming to Boost US Semiconductor Manufacturing and R&D
title_hi: अमेरिकी सेमीकंडक्टर निर्माण और अनुसंधान एवं विकास को बढ़ावा देने के उद्देश्य से बाइडेन ने कार्यकारी आदेश पर हस्ताक्षर किए
details: President Joe Biden has signed an executive order aimed at strengthening American leadership in semiconductor research, development, and manufacturing. The order directs federal agencies to identify ways to support the domestic semiconductor industry, address supply chain vulnerabilities, and ensure U.S. competitiveness in this critical sector. This move comes amid global chip shortages and increasing geopolitical competition in advanced technology.
hook: क्या अमेरिका वापस सेमीकंडक्टर के क्षेत्र में नंबर वन बन पाएगा?
